From 3faf12cd8603e3efbcc7e570e07dfd1ea2a17095 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Date: Fri, 7 Oct 2011 08:31:41 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: tegra: fix compilation error due to mach/hardware.h
 removal

This fixes a compilation error in cpu-tegra.c which was introduced in
dc8d966bccde ("ARM: convert PCI defines to variables") which removed the
now obsolete mach/hardware.h from the mach-tegra subtree.

Signed-off-by: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Signed-off-by: Olof Johansson <olof@lixom.net>
Cc: Sergei Shtylyov <sshtylyov@ru.mvista.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c b/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
index 0e1016a827ac..0e0fd4d889bd 100644
--- a/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
+++ b/arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c
@@ -32,7 +32,6 @@
 
 #include <asm/system.h>
 
-#include <mach/hardware.h>
 #include <mach/clk.h>
 
 /* Frequency table index must be sequential starting at 0 */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/mach-tegra/cpu-tegra.c`**
   - **Removed Line**: The line `#include <mach/hardware.h>` was deleted from the file. This change addresses a compilation error that arose after the removal of the `mach/hardware.h` header file in a previous commit.

### Relationships

- The modification in `cpu-tegra.c` is directly related to a prior change (commit `dc8d966bccde`) that eliminated the `mach/hardware.h` file. The removal of the include statement in `cpu-tegra.c` resolves the compilation error that occurred due to the absence of this header, ensuring that the code compiles successfully without it.

ARM: tegra: fix compilation error due to mach/hardware.h
 removal

This fixes a compilation error in cpu-tegra.c which was introduced in
dc8d966bccde ("ARM: convert PCI defines to variables") which removed the
now obsolete mach/hardware.h from the mach-tegra subtree.

Signed-off-by: Marc Dietrich <marvin24@gmx.de>
Signed-off-by: Olof Johansson <olof@lixom.net>
Cc: Sergei Shtylyov <sshtylyov@ru.mvista.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the `mach/hardware.h` header file in a previous commit, which led to a compilation error in `cpu-tegra.c` due to the absence of necessary definitions or declarations that were previously provided by this header.

Here is the patch:

-#include <mach/hardware.h>
 #include <mach/clk.h>
